title: Great App! But the Vertical Calendar Confuses Me
body:
I love this app and how it helps me keep track of my habit. It has helped me a lot and I use it on a daily basis. 

One of the feedback I have is the calendar feature that tracks my progress whenever I log my habit. It confuses me honestly. I have been using since it launched and I still haven’t gotten used to it. I always look forward to looking at the calendar and tracking my progress overtime but the calendar format makes it seem like I am not making progress at all with the way it’s arranged. Regular calendars go horizontally, and not vertically.

I would really love if the team could look into that. Otherwise, the app is great! Thanks to the team for building such a useful app.
author: Adekems

title: Great App
body: I’m glad to have this app, because atomic habits was of great help to me and it’s also well organized.
